limitations: Retrospective comparison on the existing chronological holdout, not a new independent dataset.
Three seeds vary initialization, not dataset membership; standard deviation is not a confidence interval.
Seed-42 deployed model was originally GPU-trained; added runs train on CPU with the same optimization settings.
Architecture ablations change inputs and parameter counts; they do not compare all published fraud detectors.
Yelp filtering labels are imperfect; performance on unlabelled user files or other domains is unmeasured.

models.concat: The same text and graph branches joined by concatenation; no text-conditioned relation attention or learned fusion gate.
models.graph_only: Fourteen numeric features and three GraphSAGE branches with learned global relation weights; no text embeddings.
models.neurograph: Deployed architecture: RoBERTa, three metadata GraphSAGE branches, text-conditioned relation attention and gated fusion.
models.text_only: Frozen RoBERTa text embeddings and an MLP; no metadata or graph inputs.

relations.rsr: same product and rating, historic to candidate, capped at 50
relations.rtr: same product within 30 days, historic to candidate, capped at 50
relations.rur: same reviewer, historic to candidate, capped at 50

stress_test.name: Missing graph context
stress_test.scope: Edge removal sensitivity; not a validated adversarial or LLM camouflage test

training.seed42_neurograph: Original sealed deployed checkpoint, no retraining or test-based replacement
